It gained popularity during the Middle Ages due to its association with the Blessed Virgin Mary, the mother of Jesus, whose name was derived from the Hebrew name Miriam (which means 'beloved' or 'replied of God). Thus, the name Maridel carries a rich cultural history rooted in Christian faith and ideals.
